title: Senior Analyst, Applications Programming
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Analyst will primarily focus on Oracle PL/SQL development for new projects, complex system enhancements, and production defect resolution, while also supporting critical production workflows across multiple environments. This role is suited for an experienced professional who brings strong technical depth in database development, advanced PL/SQL programming, and SQL performance tuning. The person in this role will work closely with technical and functional teams to design, develop, test, optimize, and maintain scalable solutions that improve business processes and system performance. In addition to hands-on development, the role also includes analyzing system issues, improving application efficiency, and supporting operational continuity through timely resolution of production issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain Oracle SQL and advanced PL/SQL solutions for new projects, system enhancements, and defect fixes
* Analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable technical solutions
* Perform advanced SQL and PL/SQL performance tuning to improve application efficiency and database performance
* Follow SDLC processes across design, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex application and production issues in collaboration with internal teams
* Support batch or workflow scheduling processes across multiple environments, as needed
* Review existing code and recommend improvements for performance, maintainability, and reliability
* Work independently on assigned deliverables while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Collaborate effectively with technical and functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions on time

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with RDBMS, Oracle SQL, and PL/SQL development
* Advanced PL/SQL programming skills, including writing efficient packages, procedures, functions, and queries
* Strong experience in SQL and PL/SQL performance tuning and query optimization
* Experience with Shell or Batch scripting
* Experience with batch or workflow scheduling tools such as Maestro, Control-M, or Windows Task Scheduler
* Experience working with Oracle 11g and 19c
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and functional teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description:**
**Job Description\***
This role is part of Enterprise Independent Testing (EIT) – Retail Credit Operations (RCO) Testing. EIT is a control function that performs independent testing to ensure robust governance and appropriate oversight process is in place. It assesses that controls are effective, complete, and appropriate through our risk management process – Identify, Measure, Monitor and Control. Testing is performed on controls set in various stage of product life cycle for Home Loans, Mortgage and Vehicle Servicing Operations, Financial Center Operations, and others, to determine the effectiveness, applicability, completeness, accuracy and timeliness for various activities performed by RCO teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Ability to understand the functionality of the tests being conducted and write meaningful test scripts and cases.
* To complete testing for various controls per the department’s calendar/schedule in a time bound manner without any deviations.
* Reporting/Escalation of testing discrepancies, issues and/or questions to appropriate contact.
* Ability to work independently & challenge the Line of business with the gaps identified as applicable.
* To work closely with Onshore and Offshore Processes and test effectiveness of controls.
* Ensure that all testing documentation is audit compliant.
* Gather and analyze requirements
* Assist in preparing and reviewing the process test strategy and test plan
* Review and validate test results and defect reported by the EIT Testers
* Defect and issue identification, logging, tracking, resolution, and reporting
* Tasks status communication to Leadership Team (EIT- Team Manager)
* Ensure testing commitments are met and communicate potential impacts to target dates to the LOB Partners/Leadership Team
* Identify risk to testing and communicate to the EIT- Team Manager
* Help identify and implement new process improvement.
* Assist in existing process improvements. Adhere to all EIT - Testing processes and procedures
* Conduct Training for new EIT Team members.
* Build and manage strong working relationships

title: Scada Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Automation Software Engineer (PLC / SCADA Experienced)**

Position: Automation Software Engineer

 Experience: 3–5 Years

Total Open Positions: 4

Qualification: B.E./ B. Tech – Computer Science (CS), Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics & Communication (EC), or Instrumentation & Control (IC)

**Role Summary**

CereBulb is looking for skilled Automation Software Engineers with hands-on experience on Industrial Automation, PLC / RTU / SCADA development, PLC / RTU / Instrumentation integration, PLC programming and web-based cloud application deployment for industrial solutions and software. The ideal candidate should have expertise in Wonderware, AVEVA System Platform, Tailwind SCADA, and Schneider systems like EcoStruxure Automation Platform, EcoStruxure Process Expert, Ecostruxure automation expert for designing, commissioning, and supporting automation projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain SCADA/HMI applications using Wonderware and AVEVA System Platform.
* Program, configure, and troubleshoot Schneider PLC systems.
* Design, implement, and support Tailwind SCADA applications.
* Integrate PLC, SCADA, and industrial communication systems.
* Perform testing, commissioning, and on-site support for automation projects.
* Troubleshoot automation and control system issues to ensure reliable plant operations.
* Prepare technical documentation, commissioning reports, and system backups.
* Coordinate with project, electrical, and instrumentation teams for successful project execution.

**Basic core required criteria and skills:**

* 3–5 years of experience in Industrial software and Automation.
* Strong working knowledge of Wonderware.
* Experience with AVEVA System Platform.
* Hands-on experience in Tailwind SCADA.
* Proficiency in Schneider Electric RTU / Process Controllers / Communication / Programming and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, Ethernet/IP, etc.
* Willingness to travel for project commissioning as and when required.
* Additional instrumentation background would be added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **System Design & Programming:**
  Develop and configure Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs), and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems.
* **Integration:**
  Integrate field instrumentation, sensors, Frequency Drives (VFD’s), and other actuators in electrical network / Water management system and Integrated Command and control Centre.
* **Testing & Commissioning:**
  Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and on-site system commissioning to ensure equipment reliability and safety compliance.
* **Troubleshooting & Maintenance:**
  Diagnose hardware and software faults on the shop floor to minimize unplanned equipment downtime and complete the project with on time delivery.
* **Documentation:**
  Create and update electrical schematics, functional design specifications (FDS), and standard operating procedures.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

·      
**Education:**
Computer Science (CS), Electrical Engineering (EE), Electronics & Communication (EC), or Instrumentation & Control (IC)

* **Technical Knowledge:**
  Proficiency in RTU / PLC / SCADA programming software (e.g., Schneider Electric, AVEVA, Tailwind SCADA), and industrial networks.
* **Hardware Expertise:**
  Added advantage if familiarity persist with VFDs, control panel wiring, and field instrumentation devices.
* **Soft Skills:**
  Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving under pressure, and cross-functional collaboration with mechanical and IT teams.
* **Cloud based deployment:**
  Fundamental knowledge in deployment, specification, data management, Cyber security and integration of virtual platform.

description:

*all*

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
Responsible for addressing and improve product and equipment -specific issues. Collaborating with other Equipment Engineering teams to implement new products and monitor existing products. Serve as the primary point of contact for product-specific engineering issues and acts as a liaison with outside departments including Manufacturing, Process, TSE, PE, QA and Planning. Liaised with QA group for quality improvement by introducing efficient working method, safety working environment, line audit, equipment health check and process and equipment improvement.
  
  
Responsibilities and Tasks
  
  
Evaluate and Improve Assigned Assembly Manufacturing Processes, Materials, and/or Equipment

* Maintain Equipment knowledge as it relates to the process

* Apply DOE techniques
* Perform containment of process and equipment deviations
* Determine root cause
* Implement corrective action
* Maintain knowledge of equipment and materials and how they interact
* Monitor Assembly process SPC and implement working procedures, process specification , FMEA and OCAP for line personnel

Evaluate Future Process, Equipment and/or Material Technologies

* Locate and research technical information on equipment, materials, and/or processes in journals, literature, web, etc
* Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers
* Identify supplier’s materials or equipment design and production processes
* Create decision matrix for equipment and material selection

Coordinate Equipment and/or Material Procurement
  
  

* Maintain knowledge of process, equipment, and material requirements
* Follow equipment safety requirements
* Define quality and performance requirements
* Maintain Kknowledge of procurement document requirements and format
* Follow Micron Capital Equipment Procedures (MICAP)
* Maintain working knowledge of Assembly’s equipment installation procedures

* Maintain knowledge SAP MATREQ (Materials Requisition) program to look up and order spare parts
* Maintain knowledge of equipment tracking programs: ETI (Equipment Tracking Interface), ETReports, ETMaint.

Develop Process of Record (POR)
  
  

* Define process variables
* Determine major contributing factors or variables and their interactions using DOE techniques
* Define process edges and center the process (CPK)
* Assembly in-line process control and working towards assembly yield continuous improvement

Qualify New Process, Equipment and/or Material
  
  

* Define and implement quality systems
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly’s qualification procedures
* Maintain knowledge of Quality and Reliability Assurance (QRA).
* Cost reduction project by working closely with other team member such development group, material and equipment supplier

Implement New Process, Equipment and/or Material
  
  

* Define and maintain operation, maintenance, and energy isolation procedures
* Review current procedures on an on-going basis
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly On-Line Document System (AODS)
* Maintain knowledge of change communication procedures: ECN (Engineering Change Notice), Inbox, emails
* Maintain knowledge of material attributes (shelf life, storage requirements, etc.)
* Ensure materials compatibility with equipment and parameters
* Maintain knowledge of supplier’s constraints
* Maintain knowledge of new chemical/material approval process and MICIS (Micron Chemical Information Systems)

Coordinate Training Requirements and Conduct Training
  
  

* Develop, or coordinate development of, training materials for existing equipment
* Coordinate and conduct technical training with Engineering and Equipment Support (EES) group
* Conduct training for production trainers
* Train and mentor others

Contribute to a Safe and Compliant Work Environment
  
  

* Identify and promptly report hazards
* Follow safety procedures and area work rules (including use of proper PPE, energy isolation, and chemical safety)

Use of Artificial Intelligence in few projects
  
  

* Operate and maintain equipment and tools within manufacturer and company guidelines
* Use proper lifting techniques and work in an ergonomically correct manner
